_about: SHELF of Chinese, Tibetan and Japanese classics in English before 1931 that no other shelf holds: the Chinese Buddhist pilgrims to India (Beal's Si-yu-ki of Xuanzang and Life of Hiuen-Tsiang, Takakusu's I-tsing, H. A. Giles's Fa-hsien), Rockhill's Life of the Buddha from Tibetan works and his Udanavarga (the Tibetan Dhammapada), Dawa-Samdup and Evans-Wentz's Tibetan Book of the Dead (1927), and Japan's two founding chronicles (Chamberlain's Kojiki, Aston's Nihongi). Legge's Fa-hien is on the legge shelf. Each title gates on its own translator. Printings before 1931 only. US public domain. Added 2026-10-17 by lane C (round 67); Adam may veto. No uids minted.
_name_words_note: Translator names only: fetch_shelf.py treats them as the identity check.
_surname_note: Per title: the translator's name forms.
